request.subject: UNIT:CULT:HERALD

layers.text: Make the creature taller without making it wider: lengthen the bell-shaped starry robe downward so that its round hem touches the very bottom edge of the image, and lengthen the tentacles of the crown upward so that their tips touch the very top edge of the image. Keep the one big round eye, the collar, the stars, the hanging sleeves, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
